plugin.list.doc: Every plugin and child plugin on this computer, with its state and reason.

plugin.get.doc: One plugin: its manifest, provenance, capabilities, hosts, findings and last log lines.

plugin.setEnabled.doc: Switches a plugin or child on or off; switching a parent off switches its children off (§5.1).

plugin.setScope.doc: The user's override of a plugin's scope; null goes back to the manifest's (§5.1).

plugin.setComputers.doc: Ticks the computers a local server or a `chosen` host half runs on; Mirror ticks every computer (§9.1).

plugin.restart.doc: Restarts a plugin that stopped after crashes (§5.1).

plugin.settings.get.doc: A plugin's settings with their values (a bot's, for `bot` settings); secret fields say only whether they are set.

plugin.settings.set.doc: Sets one of a plugin's settings; bots can't (§9.1), and from a layer it is a sealed card (§5.5).

plugin.auth.list.doc: A plugin's sign-ins and their state, for Settings and the welcome guide (§3.3, §5.1).

plugin.auth.signIn.doc: Signs in with one `auth` entry: a key is stored; `oauth-pkce` returns the URL to open and the core finishes on the redirect; `custom` runs its handler on the refresher (§8.5).

plugin.auth.signOut.doc: Signs out of one `auth` entry and deletes its secret everywhere.

plugin.install.doc: Downloads or wraps a plugin into the plugins folder. The user's own install is its OK (§5.1).

plugin.remove.doc: Removes a top-level plugin everywhere; its data folder and synced store stay (§5.1).

plugin.update.doc: Checks the indexes now and updates plugins that aren't pinned, forward only (§5.1).

plugin.pin.doc: Pins an index plugin to its version, or lets it update again.

plugin.renameFolder.doc: The one-click rename of a folder whose name isn't its manifest's id (§5.1).

plugin.confirmAdult.doc: The user confirms they are 18 or older, so adult plugins may be switched on (§5.7).

plugin.dev.add.doc: Adds a development folder: a sealed card unless the user adds it in their own terminal (§5.6).

plugin.dev.renew.doc: Keeps a development folder on for another 24 hours (§5.6).

plugin.index.list.doc: The indexes plugins come from; the official one first.

plugin.index.add.doc: Adds another index by URL with its key, after a warning (§5.1, §14.2 item 25).

plugin.index.remove.doc: Removes an index that isn't the official one.

plugin.index.search.doc: Searches the indexes, for the plugin index browser.

plugin.ui.doc: Every running plugin's UI, for the app's plugin runtime to mount in layers (§5.5).

point.list.doc: Every extension point, the core's and those plugins declare, with occupants and waiting entries.

command.list.doc: Every plugin command, for the palette (§5.4).

command.run.doc: Runs `<namespace>.<name>` at once, with no model turn; the handler is told who called (§5.4).

glossary.query.doc: `Glossary` for an ACP agent through its bridge (§6.8, §9.3); bots call the tool in-process.

pluginHost.start.doc: Starts a plugin's host half: a worker in a shared process, or a process of its own.

pluginHost.stop.doc: Stops a host half; calls in flight get the grace period, then are recorded as interrupted (§5.1).

pluginHost.invoke.doc: Calls a handler in the plugin's worker, telling it who called (§5.4).

pluginHost.cancel.doc: Cancels an invocation (an interrupt, a timeout, a stop).

pluginHost.feed.doc: The next piece of a streamed call's input, for the handler's input iterable.

pluginHost.deliver.doc: A value for one of a host half's watches (`points.watch`, `approvals.watch`, …); the host hands it only to that plugin's worker.

pluginHost.api.doc: A plugin's host half calls the plugin API (§5.4). A watch's result is `{ subscription }`.

pluginHost.chunk.doc: The next piece of a stream: a streamed handler's output, or a streamed argument of an API call.

pluginHost.unwatch.doc: Ends one of a host half's watches; a worker's watches also end when it stops.

pluginHost.state.doc: The plugin host reports a worker's state; the registry applies the crash rules (§5.1).

plugin_changed.doc: A plugin's state, switch or reason changed.

plugin_found.doc: A new folder in the plugins directory waits for the user's OK.

plugin_auth_changed.doc: One of a plugin's sign-ins changed state.

plugin_ui_changed.doc: These plugins' UI changed; the app re-reads `plugin.ui` and remounts them.

commands_changed.doc: The command list changed; clients re-read `command.list`.

plugin_log.doc: A plugin's new log line, for Settings while it is open.

dev_folder_reloaded.doc: A development folder reloaded; the tray lists each reload (§5.6).
